v26_field_authority.description: Register V26.1 field-header authority inside the existing runtime registry and contract guard. Keep the sealed lineage root, runtime call graph and release identity stable. FACT and DERIVED remain system-owned; PLAN is Agent2-owned; Agent3 may reference plan values but may not originate them. Authority validation must not inspect or rewrite business wording in SEMANTIC fields. SystemStage remains control-plane owned while OperationStage is an Agent3 business surface for the next graph migration.
